intended_use: Rejection is non-mutating and diagnostics are stable and payload-free.
expected: Every rejected operation (permit mismatch, replay, clock failure, handle failure, invalid or terminal transition) leaves manager, session, consumed-set, counter, and authority-baseline state byte-identical and returns an ordered, payload-free diagnostic.
setup: Full-snapshot fixtures (TransitionFixtureSnapshot) capturing manager, session, consumed permit/session sets, quota counters, live-session count, and both time-authority regression baselines before and after each rejected operation.
observed: Internal worker CTest run (sandbox): the 8 unit case IDs NOMUT-01, NOMUT-02, NOMUT-03, NOMUT-04, NOMUT-05, NOMUT-06, DIA-01, DIA-05 all passed (part of T4 107/107 unit; 0 failures). NOMUT-01..NOMUT-06 assert byte-identical state after each rejection; DIA-01 asserts a payload-free single-code diagnostic (size 1, no locator) and DIA-05 asserts precedence-ordered accumulation.
limitation: Internal worker evidence only; payload-free ordered diagnostics are verified for this candidate's diagnostic vocabulary, not predecessor diagnostics.
